content: Vaccination campaign microplanning: daily team workload is a planning parameter (e.g. target ~80 persons/team/day in one COVID campaign) set per local conditions (accessibility, distance, security), not a universal constant; team microplans specify houses/children to reach, route, start/end points. Real-world team-day output varies widely (5-80 depending on setting), so a coverage plausibility check should flag extreme ratios (settlements-per-team-day, population-per-team) against a configurable local norm rather than a fixed global number.
